threads.body:
@copilot Update this PR directly to name the independent suspend-function annotation selector kotlinx-coroutines-suspend-annotations instead of kotlinx-coroutines-annotations. Do not create a follow-up PR.

The current name sounds like it controls all Kotlin coroutine annotations, although this module only instruments @WithSpan on methods declared with suspend. The intended flat property is otel.instrumentation.kotlinx-coroutines-suspend-annotations.enabled. Ordinary coroutine context propagation and @WithSpan on non-suspend methods, including methods returning Flow, must remain independent and unchanged.

Rename the selector in AnnotationInstrumentationModule and update directly related configuration references, metadata, the existing breaking-change entry, README examples, and stale PR description wording. Inspect selector-dependent tests, configuration mappings, and declarative enablement as applicable so the renamed selector actually works consistently. Preserve the PR's existing selector-isolation and compatibility intent; do not reintroduce broad aliases that also control default-on instrumentation. Keep emitted telemetry scope identities unchanged rather than renaming them to match the selector.

This PR is the bottom of an existing stack and must remain selector-only. Preserve defaultEnabled() as super.defaultEnabled() && !AgentCommonConfig.get().isV3Preview(): enabled outside v3 preview, disabled within preview. Do not introduce the upper PR's unconditional default-off behavior here. Keep ordinary propagation and Flow support unchanged. Do not modify upper PR #20578, its branch, or stack metadata, and preserve this PR's current base and ready/draft state. The upper PR's README restructuring and default-off opt-in updates are a separate dependent deliverable, not part of this assignment.

Validate the selector behavior and directly affected documentation/configuration checks using repository conventions. Keep the description concise, with the new property example and accurate compatibility/default semantics; no stack narration or validation inventory.

replies.body: Updated in `b91c2c5a`: the selector is now `kotlinx-coroutines-suspend-annotations`; defaults, Flow/non-suspend annotation selection, and telemetry scope identity are preserved.

threads.body: [Config] The PR description advertises `otel.instrumentation.kotlinx-coroutines-annotations.enabled`, but this module registers only `kotlinx-coroutines-suspend-annotations`. Following the advertised `enabled=false` example leaves suspend annotations enabled outside v3 preview; setting it to `true` does not enable them within preview. Update the PR description and configuration example to use `otel.instrumentation.kotlinx-coroutines-suspend-annotations.enabled`, matching the implementation, README, and changelog.

replies.body: Updated the PR description to use `otel.instrumentation.kotlinx-coroutines-suspend-annotations.enabled=false`, matching the implementation, README, and changelog.
